recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Cinnamon Sugar Donut Bites
steps: Mix the cottage cheese, flour and baking powder to a soft dough.
With damp hands roll into about 16 balls.
Air fry in a greased basket at 350°F (175°C) for 8–9 minutes until lightly golden.
Mix the sugar and cinnamon. Brush or roll each warm bite in butter, then coat in cinnamon sugar. Serve warm.
recipes.notes: Ingredients, steps and calories are the creator's; she only lists calories, so protein, carbs and fat are my estimate. Makes about 16 bites (4 each).
